## Calendlytrigger Workflow

**Purpose**: ### Create/update Mautic contact on a new Calendly event
1. `On new event` triggers on new Calendly events.
2. `Create/update contact` will create a contact in Mautic or update the contact's first name. If the contact's email is already in Mautic, then the first name will be overwritten to the new first name.

**Services needed**: calendlyTrigger, mautic, stopAndError

**Difficulty**: auto-deploy

**Setup**:
1. Configure credentials for the services above
2. Update any hardcoded IDs / URLs
3. Test with sample data before activating

_Source: https://github.com/Zie619/n8n-workflows_
_Curated by ai-ops-architect on 2026-05-05_
